final: WITH disp_by_freq AS (SELECT a.frequency, COUNT(*) as count FROM disp d INNER JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, AVG(count) as avg_count FROM disp_by_freq) SELECT f.frequency, f.count, CAST(f.count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as count_div_total, CAST(f.count AS FLOAT) / t.avg_count as count_div_avg FROM disp_by_freq f CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY f.frequency
